sanskrit: ugrāyudhāya devāya namaḥ suravarāya ca namo 'stu bahurūpāya namaś ca bahudhanvine
english: Homage to the god of dreadful weapons, and to the best of the gods; homage be to him of manifold forms, and homage to him who wields many bows.

sanskrit: namo 'stu sthāṇave nityaṃ suvratāya sudhanvine namo 'stu tripuraghnāya bhagaghnāya ca vai namaḥ
english: Homage forever to Sthāṇu, the firm of vows, the bearer of the goodly bow; homage to the slayer of Tripura, and homage indeed to him who struck down Bhaga.

sanskrit: vanaspatīnāṃ pataye narāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ apāṃ ca pataye nityaṃ yajñānāṃ pataye namaḥ
english: Homage to the lord of the forest trees, to the lord of men; homage forever to the lord of the waters, and homage to the lord of sacrifices.

sanskrit: pūṣṇo dantavināśāya tryakṣāya varadāya ca nīlakaṇṭhāya piṅgāya svarṇakeśāya vai namaḥ
english: Homage to the destroyer of Pūṣan's teeth, to the three-eyed boon-giver, to the blue-throated, the tawny, the golden-haired indeed.

sanskrit: karmāṇi caiva divyāni mahādevasya dhīmataḥ tāni te kīrtayiṣyāmi yathāprajñaṃ yathāśrutam
english: And the divine deeds of the wise Mahādeva — these I shall recount to you, as far as my understanding reaches and as I have heard them.

sanskrit: na surā nāsurā loke na gandharvā na rākṣasāḥ sukham edhanti kupite tasminn api guhāgatāḥ
english: When he is angered, neither gods nor demons in the world, neither Gandharvas nor Rākṣasas, prosper in happiness — not even those who have hidden themselves in a cave.

sanskrit: vivyādha kupito yajñaṃ nirbhayas tu bhavas tadā dhanuṣā bāṇam utsṛjya saghoṣaṃ vinanāda ca
english: Enraged, Bhava, the fearless, then pierced the sacrifice, and loosing an arrow from his bow he roared aloud with a great cry.

sanskrit: te na śarma kutaḥ śāntiṃ lebhire sma surās tadā vidrute sahasā yajñe kupite ca maheśvare
english: Then the gods found no shelter, much less peace, when the sacrifice scattered all at once and Maheśvara was wroth.

sanskrit: tena jyātalaghoṣeṇa sarve lokāḥ samākulāḥ babhūvur vaśagāḥ pārtha nipetuś ca surāsurāḥ
english: At that sound of the bowstring and the palm striking it, all the worlds were thrown into turmoil, O Pārtha, and gods and demons alike, overmastered, fell down.

sanskrit: āpaś cukṣubhire sarvāś cakampe ca vasuṃdharā parvatāś ca vyaśīryanta diśo nāgāś ca mohitāḥ
english: All the waters were stirred up, the earth trembled, the mountains were shattered, and the quarters of the sky and the Nāgas were stupefied.

sanskrit: andhāś ca tamasā lokā na prakāśanta saṃvṛtāḥ jaghnivān saha sūryeṇa sarveṣāṃ jyotiṣāṃ prabhāḥ
english: And the worlds, blinded by darkness and shrouded over, gave no light, for he had stricken away, along with the Sun, the radiance of all the luminaries.

sanskrit: cukruśur bhayabhītāś ca śāntiṃ cakrus tathaiva ca ṛṣayaḥ sarvabhūtānām ātmanaś ca sukhaiṣiṇaḥ
english: And the seers, terror-stricken, cried out, and likewise performed rites of appeasement, desiring the welfare of all beings and of themselves.

sanskrit: pūṣāṇam abhyadravata śaṃkaraḥ prahasann iva puroḍāśaṃ bhakṣayato daśanān vai vyaśātayat
english: Śaṃkara, as if laughing, rushed upon Pūṣan and dashed out the teeth of the god as he was eating the sacrificial cake.

sanskrit: tato niścakramur devā vepamānā natāḥ sma tam punaś ca saṃdadhe dīptaṃ devānāṃ niśitaṃ śaram
english: Then the gods went forth, trembling and bowing low to him; and once more he fitted to the string his blazing, sharpened arrow aimed at the gods.

sanskrit: rudrasya yajñabhāgaṃ ca viśiṣṭaṃ te nv akalpayan bhayena tridaśā rājañ śaraṇaṃ ca prapedire
english: And out of fear the gods then assigned to Rudra a distinguished share in the sacrifice, O king, and took refuge with him.

sanskrit: tena caivātikopena sa yajñaḥ saṃdhitas tadā yattāś cāpi surā āsan yattāś cādyāpi taṃ prati
english: And by that very excess of his wrath the sacrifice was then restored; the gods grew watchful of him, and watchful they remain toward him even to this day.

sanskrit: asurāṇāṃ purāṇy āsaṃs trīṇi vīryavatāṃ divi āyasaṃ rājataṃ caiva sauvarṇam aparaṃ mahat
english: The mighty Asuras had three great cities in the sky: one of iron, one of silver, and another, the greatest, of gold.

sanskrit: āyasaṃ tārakākṣasya kamalākṣasya rājatam sauvarṇaṃ paramaṃ hy āsīd vidyunmālina eva ca
english: The iron city was Tārakākṣa's, the silver Kamalākṣa's, and the supreme golden one belonged to Vidyunmālin.

sanskrit: na śaktas tāni maghavān bhettuṃ sarvāyudhair api atha sarve 'marā rudraṃ jagmuḥ śaraṇam arditāḥ
english: Maghavan was unable to break those cities even with all his weapons; then all the immortals, sorely afflicted, went to Rudra for refuge.

sanskrit: te tam ūcur mahātmānaṃ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ rudra raudrā bhaviṣyanti paśavaḥ sarvakarmasu nipātayiṣyase cainān asurān bhuvaneśvara
english: All the gods, with Vāsava at their head, spoke to that great one: 'Rudra, beasts shall become the offering in all sacred rites; lay low these Asuras, O lord of the worlds.'

sanskrit: sa tathoktas tathety uktvā devānāṃ hitakāmyayā atiṣṭhat sthāṇubhūtaḥ sa sahasraṃ parivatsarān
english: Thus addressed, he said 'So be it,' and out of desire for the gods' welfare he stood motionless as a post for a thousand full years.

sanskrit: yadā trīṇi sametāni antarikṣe purāṇi vai triparvaṇā triśalyena tena tāni bibheda saḥ
english: When at last the three cities came together in the firmament, he pierced them with that three-jointed, three-barbed shaft.

sanskrit: purāṇi na ca taṃ śekur dānavāḥ prativīkṣitum śaraṃ kālāgnisaṃyuktaṃ viṣṇusomasamāyutam
english: And the Dānavas of those cities could not so much as look upon that arrow, joined with the fire of doom and conjoined with Viṣṇu and Soma.

sanskrit: bālam aṅkagataṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ pañcaśikhaṃ punaḥ umā jijñāsamānā vai ko 'yam ity abravīt surān
english: Making himself a child with five tufts of hair seated in her lap, Umā, wishing to test the gods, asked them, 'Who is this?'

sanskrit: bāhuṃ savajraṃ śakrasya kruddhasyāstambhayat prabhuḥ sa eṣa bhagavān devaḥ sarvalokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ
english: The Lord paralyzed the thunderbolt-bearing arm of the angered Śakra — he, this very god, the blessed one, sovereign of all the worlds.

sanskrit: na saṃbubudhire cainaṃ devās taṃ bhuvaneśvaram saprajāpatayaḥ sarve bālārkasadṛśaprabham
english: Yet the gods, together with the Prajāpatis, all failed to recognize him, the lord of the worlds, whose radiance was like the newly risen sun.

sanskrit: athābhyetya tato brahmā dṛṣṭvā ca sa maheśvaram ayaṃ śreṣṭha iti jñātvā vavande taṃ pitāmahaḥ
english: Then Brahmā, drawing near and beholding that Maheśvara, knew 'This is the highest,' and the Grandfather paid him homage.

sanskrit: tataḥ prasādayām āsur umāṃ rudraṃ ca te surāḥ abhavac ca punar bāhur yathāprakṛti vajriṇaḥ
english: Thereupon those gods propitiated Umā and Rudra, and the arm of the thunderbolt-wielder became once more as it had been by nature.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ prasanno bhagavān sapatnīko vṛṣadhvajaḥ devānāṃ tridaśaśreṣṭho dakṣayajñavināśanaḥ
english: The Lord, with his consort, the bull-bannered, best of the Thirty among gods, the destroyer of Dakṣa's sacrifice, was gracious to them.

sanskrit: sa vai rudraḥ sa ca śivaḥ so 'gniḥ śarvaḥ sa sarvavit sa cendraś caiva vāyuś ca so 'śvinau sa ca vidyutaḥ
english: He indeed is Rudra, and he is Śiva; he is Agni, he is Śarva, he the all-knowing; he is both Indra and Vāyu, he the Aśvins, and he the lightnings.

sanskrit: sa bhavaḥ sa ca parjanyo mahādevaḥ sa cānaghaḥ sa candramāḥ sa ceśānaḥ sa sūryo varuṇaś ca saḥ
english: He is Bhava, and he is Parjanya; he is Mahādeva, and he the sinless; he is the moon, he is Īśāna, he is the Sun, and he is Varuṇa.

sanskrit: sa kālaḥ so 'ntako mṛtyuḥ sa yamo rātryahāni ca māsārdhamāsā ṛtavaḥ saṃdhye saṃvatsaraś ca saḥ
english: He is Time, he is the Ender, he is Death; he is Yama, and the nights and days; the months, the fortnights, the seasons, the twilights, and the year — that is he.

sanskrit: sa ca dhātā vidhātā ca viśvātmā viśvakarmakṛt sarvāsāṃ devatānāṃ ca dhārayaty avapur vapuḥ
english: He is both Dhātṛ and Vidhātṛ, the soul of all, the doer of every work; and he, the formless, bears the form of all the deities.

sanskrit: sarvair devaiḥ stuto devaḥ saikadhā bahudhā ca saḥ śatadhā sahasradhā caiva tathā śatasahasradhā
english: Praised by all the gods, the god is one and yet manifold — a hundredfold, a thousandfold, and so a hundred-thousandfold.

sanskrit: īdṛśaḥ sa mahādevo bhūyaś ca bhagavān ajaḥ na hi sarve mayā śakyā vaktuṃ bhagavato guṇāḥ
english: Such is that Mahādeva, and yet more is the blessed unborn one; for not all the virtues of the Lord can be told by me.

sanskrit: sarvair grahair gṛhītān vai sarvapāpasamanvitān sa mocayati suprītaḥ śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatān
english: Those seized by every malign planet and beset with every sin — them, well pleased, he sets free, the refuge of those who come to him for refuge.

sanskrit: āyur ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ vittaṃ kāmāṃś ca puṣkalān sa dadāti manuṣyebhyaḥ sa caivākṣipate punaḥ
english: Long life, health, lordship, wealth, and abundant desires he grants to men; and he too snatches them away again.

sanskrit: sendrādiṣu ca deveṣu tasya caiśvaryam ucyate sa caiva vyāhṛte loke manuṣyāṇāṃ śubhāśubhe
english: His sovereignty is proclaimed over the gods, Indra and the rest; and it is he who ordains in the world the good and the ill of men.

sanskrit: aiśvaryāc caiva kāmānām īśvaraḥ punar ucyate maheśvaraś ca bhūtānāṃ mahatām īśvaraś ca saḥ
english: Because of his lordship over all desires he is again called the Lord; and he is Maheśvara, the great lord of beings, the lord of the mighty ones.

sanskrit: bahubhir bahudhā rūpair viśvaṃ vyāpnoti vai jagat asya devasya yad vaktraṃ samudre tad atiṣṭhata
english: With many forms in many ways he pervades the whole universe; and that mouth of this god abides within the ocean.

sanskrit: eṣa caiva śmaśāneṣu devo vasati nityaśaḥ yajanty enaṃ janās tatra vīrasthāna itīśvaram
english: And this god dwells perpetually in the cremation grounds; there men worship him, the Lord, by the name 'Abode of Heroes.'

sanskrit: asya dīptāni rūpāṇi ghorāṇi ca bahūni ca loke yāny asya kurvanti manuṣyāḥ pravadanti ca
english: His forms are blazing and terrible and many; those which men make and speak of in the world are his.

sanskrit: nāmadheyāni lokeṣu bahūny atra yathārthavat nirucyante mahattvāc ca vibhutvāt karmabhis tathā
english: His names in the worlds are many, and here they are fittingly derived, according to his greatness, his pervading power, and his deeds.

sanskrit: vede cāsya samāmnātaṃ śatarudrīyam uttamam nāmnā cānantarudreti upasthānaṃ mahātmanaḥ
english: And in the Veda the supreme Śatarudrīya is handed down concerning him, and by the name 'Endless Rudra' the worship of the great-souled one is performed.

sanskrit: sa kāmānāṃ prabhur devo ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ sa vibhuḥ sa prabhur devo viśvaṃ vyāpnuvate mahat
english: That god is lord of all desires, the heavenly and the human alike; he is the all-pervading, he the sovereign god who fills the whole great universe.

sanskrit: jyeṣṭhaṃ bhūtaṃ vadanty enaṃ brāhmaṇā munayas tathā prathamo hy eṣa devānāṃ mukhād asyānalo 'bhavat
english: The Brāhmaṇas and the sages call him the eldest of beings; for he is the first of the gods, and from his mouth the fire arose.

sanskrit: sarvathā yat paśūn pāti taiś ca yad ramate punaḥ teṣām adhipatir yac ca tasmāt paśupatiḥ smṛtaḥ
english: Because in every way he protects the creatures and again takes his delight in them, and because he is their overlord, he is therefore called Paśupati.

sanskrit: nityena brahmacaryeṇa liṅgam asya yadā sthitam mahayanti ca lokāś ca maheśvara iti smṛtaḥ
english: Because by his perpetual chastity his liṅga stands erect, and because the worlds magnify him, he is remembered as Maheśvara.

sanskrit: ṛṣayaś caiva devāś ca gandharvāpsarasas tathā liṅgam asyārcayanti sma tac cāpy ūrdhvaṃ samāsthitam
english: The seers and the gods, and likewise the Gandharvas and Apsarases, worship his liṅga, and it too stands upraised.

sanskrit: pūjyamāne tatas tasmin modate sa maheśvaraḥ sukhī prītaś ca bhavati prahṛṣṭaś caiva śaṃkaraḥ
english: When that liṅga is worshipped, Maheśvara rejoices; Śaṃkara becomes happy and pleased and well delighted.

sanskrit: yad asya bahudhā rūpaṃ bhūtabhavyabhavatsthitam sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva bahurūpas tataḥ smṛtaḥ
english: Because his form is manifold, abiding in past, future, and present, both unmoving and moving, he is therefore remembered as Bahurūpa, of many forms.

sanskrit: ekākṣo jājvalann āste sarvatokṣimayo 'pi vā krodhād yaś cāviśal lokāṃs tasmāc charva iti smṛtaḥ
english: He sits blazing as the one-eyed, or else made all of eyes on every side; and because in wrath he entered into the worlds, he is therefore remembered as Śarva.

sanskrit: dhūmraṃ rūpaṃ ca yat tasya dhūrjaṭis tena ucyate viśve devāś ca yat tasmin viśvarūpas tataḥ smṛtaḥ
english: Because his form is smoke-grey he is called Dhūrjaṭi; and because all the gods abide in him, he is therefore remembered as Viśvarūpa.

sanskrit: tisro devīr yadā caiva bhajate bhuvaneśvaraḥ dyām apaḥ pṛthivīṃ caiva tryambakaś ca tataḥ smṛtaḥ
english: And because the lord of the worlds embraces the three goddesses — heaven, the waters, and the earth — he is therefore remembered as Tryambaka.

sanskrit: samedhayati yan nityaṃ sarvārthān sarvakarmasu śivam icchan manuṣyāṇāṃ tasmād eśa śivaḥ smṛtaḥ
english: Because he ever furthers all ends in all undertakings, desiring the welfare of men, he is therefore remembered as Śiva, the auspicious.

sanskrit: sahasrākṣo 'yutākṣo vā sarvatokṣimayo 'pi vā yac ca viśvaṃ mahat pāti mahādevas tataḥ smṛtaḥ
english: Thousand-eyed, or ten-thousand-eyed, or made all of eyes on every side, and because he protects this whole great universe, he is therefore remembered as Mahādeva.

sanskrit: dahaty ūrdhvaṃ sthito yac ca prāṇotpattisthitaś ca yat sthitaliṅgaś ca yan nityaṃ tasmāt sthāṇur iti smṛtaḥ
english: Because, standing upright, he burns, and because he abides at the source of the life-breaths, and because his liṅga ever stands fixed, he is therefore remembered as Sthāṇu, the pillar.

sanskrit: viṣamasthaḥ śarīreṣu samaś ca prāṇinām iha sa vāyur viṣamastheṣu prāṇāpānaśarīriṣu
english: Dwelling unevenly in bodies, yet equal in all living beings here, he is the Vāyu coursing unevenly within the bodies as the in-breath and the out-breath.

sanskrit: pūjayed vigrahaṃ yas tu liṅgaṃ vāpi samarcayet liṅgaṃ pūjayitā nityaṃ mahatīṃ śriyam aśnute
english: Whoever worships his image, or duly honors his liṅga — he who ever worships the liṅga attains great prosperity.

sanskrit: ūrubhyām ardham āgneyaṃ somārdhaṃ ca śivā tanuḥ ātmano 'rdhaṃ ca tasyāgniḥ somo 'rdhaṃ punar ucyate
english: From the thighs upward, half his auspicious body is of fire and half of the moon; one half of himself is said to be Agni, and again the other half is Soma.

sanskrit: taijasī mahatī dīptā devebhyaś ca śivā tanuḥ bhāsvatī mānuṣeṣv asya tanur ghorāgnir ucyate
english: Toward the gods his auspicious body is fiery, vast, and blazing; among men this radiant body of his is called the dreadful fire.

sanskrit: brahmacaryaṃ caraty eṣa śivā yāsya tanus tayā yāsya ghoratarā mūrtiḥ sarvān atti tayeśvaraḥ
english: With that body of his which is auspicious he practices chastity; but with that more terrible form of his the Lord devours all things.

sanskrit: yan nirdahati yat tīkṣṇo yad ugro yat pratāpavān māṃsaśoṇitamajjādo yat tato rudra ucyate
english: Because he burns all utterly, because he is sharp, fierce, and full of scorching might, and because he is the devourer of flesh, blood, and marrow, he is therefore called Rudra.

sanskrit: eṣa devo mahādevo yo 'sau pārtha tavāgrataḥ saṃgrāme śātravān nighnaṃs tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ pinākadhṛk
english: This god is Mahādeva, he whom you, O Pārtha, beheld before you in battle, smiting down your foes — the bearer of the Pināka.

sanskrit: eṣa vai bhagavān devaḥ saṃgrāme yāti te 'grataḥ yena dattāni te 'strāṇi yais tvayā dānavā hatāḥ
english: It is this blessed god who goes before you in battle — he by whom your weapons were given, and by which you slew the Dānavas.

sanskrit: dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ puṇyaṃ vedaiś ca saṃjñitam devadevasya te pārtha vyākhyātaṃ śatarudriyam
english: The Śatarudriya of the god of gods — bestowing fortune, fame, and long life, holy, and named in the Vedas — has now been expounded to you, O Pārtha.

sanskrit: sarvārthasādhakaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakilbiṣanāśanam sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvaduḥkhabhayāpaham
english: It accomplishes all ends, it is holy, it destroys all defilements, it stills all sins, and it takes away all sorrow and fear.

sanskrit: caturvidham idaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti naraḥ sadā vijitya sarvāñ śatrūn sa rudraloke mahīyate
english: The man who ever hears this fourfold hymn of praise conquers all his enemies and is exalted in the world of Rudra.

sanskrit: caritaṃ mahātmano divyaṃ sāṃgrāmikam idaṃ śubham paṭhan vai śatarudrīyaṃ śṛṇvaṃś ca satatotthitaḥ
english: This auspicious, divine, warlike deed of the great-souled one — reciting the Śatarudrīya and hearing it, ever diligent —

sanskrit: bhakto viśveśvaraṃ devaṃ mānuṣeṣu tu yaḥ sadā varān sa kāmāṃl labhate prasanne tryambake naraḥ
english: the man who among mortals is ever devoted to the god Viśveśvara obtains the boons of his desire when Tryambaka is well pleased.

sanskrit: gaccha yudhyasva kaunteya na tavāsti parājayaḥ yasya mantrī ca goptā ca pārśvatas te janārdanaḥ
english: Go, fight, O son of Kuntī; there is no defeat for you, for at your side, as counselor and protector, stands Janārdana.

sanskrit: saṃjaya uvāca evam uktvārjunaṃ saṃkhye parāśarasutas tadā jagāma bharataśreṣṭha yathāgatam ariṃdama
english: Saṃjaya said: Having spoken thus to Arjuna on the field of battle, the son of Parāśara then departed, O best of the Bharatas, scourge of foes, by the way he had come.
